Disney Adventure: Charting a New Course | Official Trailer | Disney Cruise Line
Disney Adventure, the newest ship in the Disney Cruise Line fleet, comes to life on its journey to Singapore. Imagineers transform steel into story, creating seven themed areas through creative design and innovative technology.  For some cast and crew, it is more than curating entertainment, dining, and service – it is a heartfelt homecoming.

Disney Adventure: Charting a New Course is available starting 27 November 2026 on Disney+, National Geographic, and JioHotstar.
